title: Administrator
description:
Data Adminstrator - Hemel Hempstead

We are working exclusively with a well-established market leading business in Hemel Hempstead to recruit for a vital newly created role within their team.

Our client is looking to recruit a Data Controller to act as the central date specialist for the entire organisation across their Supply Chain, Warehouse, Workshop and Deployment departments. The successful candidate will act as the single point of data entry for all of the departments tracking all operations data via our clients existing Excel databases with a view to moving across to an ERP next year.

This role is a paying a salary upto £27k and is a great opportunity for someone to make the role their own. Please note this position is fully office based in our clients Hemel Hempstead site and ideally you will be someone that is confident using Excel.

Duties:
- Serve as the sole administrator authorized to input data into the Master Tracker.
- Review, verify, and reconcile data inputs from Deployment, Purchasing, Logistics, Engineering, Sales, and Projects.
- Maintain, protect, and audit the Master Tracker spreadsheet to ensure absolute data integrity.
- Format and standardize historical data across all six departments to prepare for seamless ERP migration.
- Document current manual workflows from each department to help inform future ERP configurations.
- Schedule fortnightly cross-functional S&OP meetings and track action items to deadline.
- Consolidate the finalized S&OP review outputs to calculate, compile, and publish the official list of required materials that need to be ordered.
- Extract and compile reports from the Master Tracker for specific requirements as requested by other departments

Candidate requirements:
- Basic-Good Excel skills - In this role you will be managing ready made spreadsheets, manipulating, populating and consistently updating data.
- Exceptional assertiveness and attention to detail to enforce data standards across multiple teams.
- Strong communication skills to collaborate with and challenge stakeholders.
- Ability to manage high volumes of data from multiple streams without sacrificing accuracy.

title: Contracts Administrator
description:
Contracts Administrator

Hemel Hempstead - Hybrid

Temporary - Hourly equivalent of £28,000 - £30,000

Immediate Start!

We're delighted to be recruiting for a world-renowned international business that provide essential products and services across its sector. With a fantastic reputation and a head office based in Hemel Hempstead, this is a brilliant opportunity to join a successful, forward-thinking organisation with modern, stylish offices and a genuinely great working environment.

We're looking for 1-2 Contracts Administrators to join the team on a temporary basis, with an immediate start available.

The role is initially approved for 4 months, however, discussions are already underway to extend the positions through to the end of 2027. If agreed, this could mean around 16 months of work, making this a very attractive opportunity for someone looking for stability for a long period of time with great opportunities for something longer term down the line too.

What will you be doing?

This is a varied administrative role where you'll support the team across contracts, quotations, tenders and customer queries. You'll be working with internal teams and customers, keeping information accurate and making sure things move forward efficiently.

Day-to-day, you can expect to:
- Enter, maintain and manage tender, contract and quotation data across ERP and CRM systems.
- Prepare and create quotes and contracts for defined product areas, working within agreed approvals and policies.
- Act as a point of contact for contractual queries and proactively work towards resolving customer requests.
- Deal with pricing queries and liaise with relevant teams to find solutions.
- Complete a range of administrative tasks relating to tenders, contracts and quotations.
- Keep information accurate and up to date while managing a varied workload and competing priorities.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who is energetic, organised and comfortable working at pace. You don't necessarily need to have worked in exactly the same role before - what's most important is that you're confident working with systems, enjoy learning and aren't afraid to ask questions.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in a back-office, administration, contracts, quotations, tenders, sales support or similar environment.
- Experience using an ERP or CRM system. SAP experience would be a huge advantage, but it is not essential - experience with another system is absolutely fine if you're confident picking up new software quickly.
- A naturally curious and inquisitive approach - someone who asks questions, wants to understand how things work and isn't afraid to get stuck in.
- The ability to work at pace and manage a busy workload without losing attention to detail.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong organisation skills with a reliable and proactive approach.
- The ability to take initiative, identify problems and look for solutions.
- A flexible attitude and willingness to learn and adapt.

SAP or Salesforce experience would be a fantastic bonus, but neither is essential. If you've used another CRM, ERP or business system and can demonstrate that you're a quick learner, we'd love to hear from you.

Working hours & benefits
- Monday to Friday, full-time hours
- Hybrid working: 3 days in the Hemel Hempstead office and 2 days working remotely
- Modern offices based in the Maylands area of Hemel Hempstead
- Free on-site parking
- Weekly pay + holiday accrual
- £28,000-£30,000 salary equivalent, depending on experience
- Immediate start available
- Initially approved for 4 months, with discussions underway to extend through to the end of 2027

Please ensure the Maylands area of Hemel Hempstead is a realistic commute for you before applying.

Interested?

If you're looking for a role where you can get stuck in, learn quickly, work with a well-known international business and potentially secure long-term temporary work through to the end of 2027, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sales Vehicle Administrator
description:
Sales Vehicle Administrator

Location: Hemel Hempstead

Salary: £32,000

Job Type: Permanent

We are currently recruiting for a Sales Vehicle Administrator to join a busy and established motor dealership.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and detail-focused administrator with previous motor dealership experience to take responsibility for the accurate and efficient administration of vehicle sales, stock, invoicing, funding and associated processes.

The successful candidate will work closely with Sales, Accounts, finance providers and other internal departments, supporting the smooth progression of vehicles from acquisition through to sale.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage accurate records for new and used vehicle stock across multiple vehicle brands.
- Monitor vehicle movements, stock status and vehicle records.
- Prepare and process vehicle invoices accurately and within required timescales.
- Administer additional products and services associated with vehicle sales.
- Complete and monitor government grant applications relating to eligible electric vehicles.
- Raise vehicle settlement requests and prepare supporting documentation.
- Process administration relating to direct vehicle purchases.
- Manage vehicle funding administration and liaise with finance companies where required.
- Administer fully paid vehicles and ensure payments and documentation are correctly reconciled.
- Liaise closely with Sales, Accounts, finance providers and suppliers to resolve queries and discrepancies.
- Ensure all vehicle and sales documentation is complete, accurate and up to date.
- Maintain high standards of confidentiality when handling customer and financial information.
- Support the wider Sales and Accounts functions with general administration.
- Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and efficiency.
- Manage multiple priorities and deadlines within a fast-paced dealership environment.

About You

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous administration experience within a motor dealership - essential.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Good numerical and financial awareness.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office and dealership management systems.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player.
- The ability to manage a high volume of administration and competing priorities.

Desirable Experience
- Vehicle sales administration experience.
- New and used vehicle stock administration.
- Vehicle funding or finance administration.
- Vehicle invoicing and manufacturer processes.
- EV government grant applications.
- Working closely with an Accounts or Finance department.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is highly organised, commercially aware, proactive and dependable, with the ability to work accurately under pressure.

You will be comfortable managing a high volume of vehicle administration and confident communicating with Sales Executives, Sales Managers, Accounts teams, finance companies and other stakeholders.

Previous motor dealership administration experience is essential for this position.

If you have the relevant dealership experience and are looking for your next opportunity within a busy automotive environment, we would be keen to hear from you.

Apply now to be considered for this opportunity.
